spec-audit: Diagnose `.specs/` structure and recommend reorganizations without editing files.
spec-change: Update current product intent from a user-requested behavior change, preferring existing specs over new specs.
spec-implement: Implement behavior from current `.specs/` product intent and verify the code against the relevant specification.
spec-create: Create a new IDD spec, ADR, or spike for durable product intent.
spec-check-implementation: Check whether implementation behavior matches durable product intent in `.specs/`.
spec-import: Import raw source material into a structurally normalized IDD `.specs/` structure.
spec-lint: Run mechanical `.specs/` consistency checks without editing files.
spec-reorganize: Perform focused structural normalization of existing `.specs/` intent without changing product meaning.
spec-update-from-implementation: Update specs from confirmed implementation behavior intended as product intent.
